title: Prime Minister congratulates shooters Rudrankksh Balasaheb Patil, Himanshu Dhillon and Parth Rakesh Mane on winning Silver Medal at the Asian Games
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra has congratulated Rudrankksh Balasaheb Patil, Himanshu Dhillon and Parth Rakesh Mane on winning the Silver Medal in the 10m Air Rifle Men’s Team event at the Asian Games 2026. Shri Modi said that their focus, consistency and teamwork have made India proud.
Shri Modi posted on X:
Congratulations to Rudrankksh Balasaheb Patil, Himanshu Dhillon and Parth Rakesh Mane on winning the Silver Medal in the 10m Air Rifle Men’s Team event at the Asian Games.
It was indeed a commendable performance with a great combined score. Their focus, consistency and teamwork have made India proud. Best wishes for the endeavours ahead: PM @narendramodi
